description: Dialogue templates for NPC interactions, organized by role and personality

friendly: Welcome to {tavernName}! What can I get for you?
Good to see you, traveler! Pull up a chair and stay awhile.
Ah, a new face! Welcome, friend. We don't get many visitors these days.
Come in, come in! The fire's warm and the ale is cold!
grumpy: What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy?
Another adventurer, eh? Just don't cause any trouble.
Hmph. I suppose you'll want a room and some food.
The sign says 'open', doesn't it? What are you waiting for?
mysterious: Welcome, traveler. I've been expecting someone like you...
Ah, you've arrived. Some might say it's fate.
Interesting timing, your arrival. Very interesting indeed.
Welcome to {tavernName}. I have a feeling we'll be seeing more of each other.

friendly: Hey there! Come join me for a drink!
Well met, friend! Always good to see a new face around here.
Pull up a stool! I'll buy you a round.
Welcome! Are you passing through, or staying a while?
grumpy: New in town? Great. Just what we need.
Don't bother me unless you're buying.
jovial: Ha ha! Another adventurer! Come, let me tell you about my exploits!
Well hello there! *slaps you on the back* You look like you have stories to tell!
A new face! Excellent! The more the merrier, I always say!
*laughs heartily* Welcome, friend! The night is young!
nervous: Oh! Um, hello... you're not here to cause trouble, are you?
*glances around nervously* Oh, hi... sorry, I thought you were someone else.
Please don't hurt me! I don't have much money!

friendly: Welcome to {shopName}! How can I help you today?
Good day! Looking for supplies? You've come to the right place!
Ah, a customer! Please, browse my wares. I have the finest goods in {settlement}!
Welcome, welcome! Everything you need and more, right here!
greedy: Ah, a customer! Ready to spend some gold, I hope?
Welcome! I have many fine items... for the right price.
Yes, yes, what do you want to buy? I don't give refunds, mind you.
Looking to purchase? Good, good. I have rent to pay, you know.
stern: I run an honest shop here. No haggling, no stealing. Understood?
Yes? Do you need something, or are you just browsing?
I have quality goods at fair prices. What do you need?

friendly: Ah, welcome to the forge! Looking for quality steel?
Good day! Need a blade sharpened, or perhaps new armor?
Well met! I've just finished a fine set of weapons. Care to take a look?
Welcome! Best smithwork in the region, if I do say so myself!
grumpy: What do you want? I'm in the middle of something.
Make it quick. I've got orders to fill.
Another adventurer needing gear, I suppose. *sighs*
Yes? I don't have all day.
proud: Welcome to the finest forge in all the land!
Ah! You have a good eye for quality, I can tell. You've come to the right place.
Every piece I make is a work of art. You won't find better.
Welcome! I am the master of my craft. What can I forge for you?

wise: Ah, a visitor. What brings you to our humble settlement?
Welcome. I am {name}, {title} of {settlement}. How may I assist you?
Greetings. It's rare we see adventurers these days. What news from the road?
stern: I am {name}, {title} of {settlement}. What do you want?
We don't take kindly to troublemakers here. I trust you'll behave yourself?
Welcome to {settlement}. Obey our laws and we'll have no problems.
honorable: Welcome, brave traveler. {settlement} is honored by your visit.
Well met! I am {name}, {title} of this settlement. You are among friends here.
Greetings. Your reputation precedes you, adventurer.
Welcome to {settlement}. How may I be of service to such a valiant hero?

friendly: Ho there! Welcome to {settlement}. Try not to cause any trouble, eh?
Good day! Keeping the peace around here. Let me know if you need anything.
Well met, traveler! {settlement} is a safe place, thanks to us guards!
Welcome! Don't worry, we keep the riff-raff out of {settlement}.
stern: Move along, citizen. Nothing to see here.
Keep your weapons sheathed while in town. Understood?
I'm watching you, stranger. Don't try anything.
honorable: Welcome, traveler. I am sworn to protect {settlement} and its people.
Greetings. You'll find {settlement} a safe haven, so long as I draw breath.
Well met! I stand vigil here. You have nothing to fear within these walls.
Welcome. I serve {settlement} with honor. May I assist you?

weather: Lovely weather we're having, isn't it?
Been raining for three days straight. I'm so tired of the mud.
This heat is unbearable! I can barely work in the forge.
They say a storm is coming. Best batten down the hatches.
settlement: I've lived in {settlement} all my life. Wouldn't want to be anywhere else.
{settlement} used to be twice this size, before the war.
Not much happens around {settlement}. It's a quiet life.
We don't get many visitors in {settlement}. You're a rare sight!
Things have been peaceful in {settlement} lately. I hope it stays that way.
rumors: I heard there's been strange sounds coming from the old ruins to the north.
Merchants from the east say the roads are getting more dangerous.
Some say there's treasure hidden in the caves west of here. Cursed treasure, mind you.
The farmers have been reporting missing livestock. Probably just wolves...
There's talk of a dragon in the mountains. Just old wives' tales, I'm sure.
I heard the King is planning to raise taxes again. When will it end?
They say a famous bard is coming to town next week. Should be quite a show!
Word is there's bandits on the south road. Best be careful if you're heading that way.
personal: My back's been aching something fierce lately. Getting old, I suppose.
Business has been slow. Not many people buying these days.
I'm saving up to visit the capital someday. Always wanted to see the big city.
My daughter's getting married next month. Can you believe it?
Been in this line of work for twenty years now. Time flies.
I used to be an adventurer like you, but those days are long past.
You remind me of someone I used to know. A brave soul, just like you.
advice: If you're heading into the wilderness, bring extra rations. You can't be too careful.
Always keep your blade sharp and your wits sharper.
Trust your instincts out there. They'll keep you alive.
Make sure to rest when you can. The road is long and full of dangers.
A good map is worth its weight in gold, I always say.
If you see trouble, best to go around it. No shame in staying alive.
The old temple to the east is abandoned. Or so they say. Best steer clear.
trades: If you need provisions, talk to the merchant. Fair prices, honest goods.
The blacksmith here does excellent work. A bit pricey, but worth every copper.
Looking for healing potions? I know someone who can help with that.
Need a place to rest? The innkeeper always has rooms available.
The local herbalist makes the best remedies. Better than any potion, I reckon.

urgent: Thank the gods you're here! I desperately need your help with something...
You! You look capable. I have a problem that needs solving, and quickly!
Perfect timing! I was just about to send for help. Are you interested in some work?
This is dire. I need someone brave enough to face real danger. That you?
casual: Say, you wouldn't happen to be looking for work, would you?
I don't suppose you'd be interested in a job? It pays well...
You seem like the adventuring type. I might have something for you.
If you have some time, I could use someone with your skills.
secretive: *leans in close* I have a proposition for you, if you're interested...
*looks around nervously* Not here. Meet me outside after dark.
I need someone I can trust. Someone... discreet. Interested?
*whispers* I know something. Something valuable. Want in?
desperate: Please, you have to help me! I don't know who else to turn to!
I'll pay anything! Just please, help me with this!
*grabs your arm* You're my last hope! Please, hear me out!
I'm begging you! My family is in danger! You have to help!

questAccept: Thank you! I knew I could count on you!
Excellent! I have faith in you, adventurer.
You won't regret this. Good luck out there!
May the gods watch over you. Return safely!
I appreciate this more than you know. Be careful!
Perfect! Here's what you need to know...
Wonderful! I'll rest easier knowing you're on the case.
questDecline: Oh... I understand. Perhaps another time.
That's disappointing, but I can't force you.
I see. Well, if you change your mind...
Hmph. I thought you were braver than that.
Your loss. I'll find someone else.
Are you sure? The reward is quite generous...
questProgress: Any progress on that task I gave you?
Have you completed what I asked?
Any news? I've been waiting anxiously.
Tell me you have good news...
questComplete: You did it! I can't thank you enough!
Excellent work! Here's your reward, as promised.
You're a true hero! Please, accept this as thanks.
Wonderful! I knew you could do it!
Thank the gods! Here, you've more than earned this.
I'm forever in your debt! Thank you!
